import sys


def tokens():
    # Stream integers in 1 MiB chunks so the whole input never sits in memory as a token list.
    read = sys.stdin.buffer.read
    rest = b""
    while True:
        chunk = read(1 << 20)
        if not chunk:
            break
        chunk = rest + chunk
        cut = max(chunk.rfind(b" "), chunk.rfind(b"\n"))
        if cut < 0:
            rest = chunk
            continue
        rest = chunk[cut:]
        yield from map(int, chunk[:cut].split())
    yield from map(int, rest.split())


def main():
    it = tokens()
    n = next(it, 0)
    write = sys.stdout.write
    if n == 0:
        write("\n")
        return
    seen = bytearray(n + 1)  # seen[0] stays 0 and stops the pointer
    last = n  # rightmost position that is still 0
    k = 1 - n
    out = []
    append = out.append
    for p in it:
        seen[p] = 1
        if p == last:
            while seen[last]:
                last -= 1
        k += 1
        # answer = k - (n - last) + 1
        append(k + last)
        if len(out) == 65536:
            write(" ".join(map(str, out)))
            write(" ")
            out.clear()
    write(" ".join(map(str, out)))
    write("\n")


main()
